title: Part 3 — then charge him
description: Series Part 3: take their claims at full strength — the ham-sandwich bar to charge, “the trifecta” of corroboration (Hasan Piker), the dangerous-man portrait — then it is incumbent upon the state to charge him. So why is no one asking it to?
alt_text: Dark card, part 3 of 3: Why is no one calling for an investigation? Take their claims at full strength — all of them: “You can indict a ham sandwich” — the bar to charge is famously low. “The trifecta” of corroborating evidence — commentator Hasan Piker’s description of the case. And Platner is, they say, a dangerous man — the portrait painted across 35 catalogued stories. Amber italic: Then it is incumbent upon the state to charge him. So why is no one asking it to?
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
